passage.label: Al-Baqarah — do not say ra'ina but unzurna; People of Book and mushrikeen wish no good sent to believers; Allah selects mercy for whom He wills; abrogation (naskh) bringing better or similar; Allah's dominion over heavens and earth; no protector besides Allah; asking messenger as Musa was asked exchanges faith for disbelief; many People of Book wish to turn believers back to kufr out of envy after truth became clear; pardon and overlook until Allah's command

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَقُولُواْ رَٰعِنَا وَقُولُواْ ٱنظُرۡنَا وَٱسۡمَعُواْۗ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

مَّا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَلَا ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرٖ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَخۡتَصُّ بِرَحۡمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
۞مَا نَنسَخۡ مِنۡ ءَايَةٍ أَوۡ نُنسِهَا نَأۡتِ بِخَيۡرٖ مِّنۡهَآ أَوۡ مِثۡلِهَآۗ أَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ
أَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
أَمۡ تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَسۡـَٔلُواْ رَسُولَكُمۡ كَمَا سُئِلَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبۡلُۗ وَمَن يَتَبَدَّلِ ٱلۡكُفۡرَ بِٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ

وَدَّ كَثِيرٞ مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَوۡ يَرُدُّونَكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ إِيمَٰنِكُمۡ كُفَّارًا حَسَدٗا مِّنۡ عِندِ أَنفُسِهِم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَٱعۡفُواْ وَٱصۡفَحُواْ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

mainSubject.label: Believers commanded not to say ra'ina but to say unzurna and listen; painful punishment for disbelievers; neither People of Book who disbelieved nor mushrikeen wish any good sent down from Lord; Allah selects for His mercy whom He wills and is possessor of great bounty; whatever ayah is abrogated or forgotten is replaced with better or similar; Allah over all things qadeer; Allah owns mulk of heavens and earth; no waliyy or naseer besides Allah; intending to question messenger as Musa was questioned before leads to straying from sound path; exchanging kufr for iman means losing the way; many People of Book wish to turn believers back to kufr out of hasad after truth became clear; commanded to pardon and overlook until Allah brings His command; Allah over all things qadeer

Inappropriate questioning of prophet as sign of weak faith

notes: Pass A pilot 7, passage 18/3. Contains the naskh (abrogation) principle in 2:106, speech etiquette correction in 2:104, and diagnosis of envy-driven opposition in 2:109. Links to prior passages on People of Book hostility.
